It runs a fixed six-step workflow: (1) data-quality check with a pause for user confirmation before any processing, (2) structured classification into an editable Excel master table, (3) buyer-persona and usage-scenario analysis with charts, (4) positive/negative attribution for word-of-mouth drivers and optimization opportunities, (5) competitor/reference-object mention analysis, and (6) a visualized HTML report. Trigger phrases include "分析评论", "评论分析", "用户评价分析", "买家评价", "电商评论", "口碑分析", "评价归因", "生成评价报告".
